title: Omron PLC FINS/TCP Connection Issue in Ignition 8.1.44
body: An Omron PLC is reachable by ping, but Ignition 8.1.44 cannot establish FINS/TCP communication. What PLC and Ignition FINS settings should be checked, how should TCP port 9600 be verified, and how should FINS network/node/unit addressing be matched?

title: Allen-Bradley SLC 5/03 USR-N540 Serial/Ethernet Replacement
body: A technician wants to replace an existing 1747-UIC connection to an SLC 5/03 with a USR-N540 serial/Ethernet device. Is that compatible, and what SLC Channel 0 protocol/configuration must be checked before configuring the replacement?

title: Mitsubishi FX5U Communication with Baykon BX11-EN Indicators
body: A technician is migrating an older FX3U/FX3-ENET system to an FX5U and needs to communicate with two Baykon BX11-EN indicators over Ethernet. How should the FX5U and indicators be configured, should Simple CPU Communication or ladder messaging be used, and how should the old port/register mapping be validated?
symptom: FX3U to FX5U migration with Baykon indicators
